generation.scope: Prove all-degree regularity on the residual twisted cubic whenever the auxiliary binary determinant is integral (including nodal and cuspidal curves), identically zero, or has a ruling fiber. Integral genus-one addition links sets of at most four secant pencils in every position. The only remaining auxiliary divisors are pairs of (1,1) graphs and doubled (1,1) graphs.

open_mathematics: Analyze the two Moebius-graph and doubled-graph degenerations of the auxiliary determinant. Then continue finite point graphs, higher projection fibers, and global parameter components and specializations.
